## StickyBar.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `position` :: Which edge of the scroll container the bar sticks to.
- `offset` :: How far the stuck bar sits from that edge, as a CSS length.
- `surface` :: The surface the bar takes on once it is stuck. @default 'glass'
- `children` :: The bar's content — a toolbar, a title, or a save row.

## sticky-bar.ts

### `function scrollParent`

Walks up from `node` to the nearest scroll container, or `null` for the viewport.
